registryPolicy: The v1.2 catalog is a mandatory floor, never a ceiling. New governed capabilities may be appended without a maximum.

entries.label: Current build and application version
entries.notes: Package version is safe; absent build identity is shown as unavailable.

entries.label: Git SHA
entries.notes: Shown only when a canonical deployment source provides it.

entries.label: Environment
entries.notes: Only the bounded environment class is projected.

entries.label: Database state
entries.notes: No database repair or raw database access in Phase 1.

entries.label: Storage state
entries.notes: Safe health only; credentials and private object keys are excluded.

entries.label: Active users
entries.notes: Aggregate count; person-level access remains separately governed.

entries.label: Current sessions
entries.notes: Never raw cookies, CSRF values, or token hashes.

entries.label: Accounts
entries.notes: Person-level reads require exact purpose and grant where sensitive.

entries.label: Profiles
entries.notes: Phase 1 provides only bounded Profile diagnostics.

entries.label: Email state
entries.notes: Verification state may be projected; address value is excluded from ordinary support diagnostics.

entries.label: Roles and capabilities
entries.notes: Phase 1 mutation is limited to explicit bootstrap reconciliation outside the web shell.

entries.label: Linked providers
entries.notes: Provider tokens and linking secrets are always excluded.

entries.label: Sessions
entries.notes: Bounded metadata only; no session secrets.

entries.label: Devices
entries.notes: Device labels require a later privacy projection.

entries.label: Security events
entries.notes: Event types and bounded safe metadata only.

entries.label: Chronicle history metadata
entries.notes: Private prose, reflections, Memory bodies, and media are excluded.

entries.label: Installed Community packages
entries.notes: No package keys or private assets.

entries.label: Active sessions pinned to editions
entries.notes: Aggregate and edition binding metadata only.

entries.label: Copyright reports
entries.notes: Registered for a later governed legal workflow.

entries.label: Privacy reports
entries.notes: Registered for a later governed privacy workflow.

entries.label: OAuth configuration
entries.notes: Provider secrets and tokens are never exposed.

entries.label: Storage providers
entries.notes: Credentials and private object keys are never exposed.

entries.label: Logging
entries.notes: Sensitive data must never be enabled in logs.

entries.label: Actor
entries.notes: Canonical account actor and bounded role/capability basis.

entries.label: Before and after summary
entries.notes: Field-aware bounded summaries only; never raw objects.

entries.label: Support grant and authorization basis
entries.notes: Grant identifiers are evidence references, not bearer secrets.

entries.label: IP and session metadata
entries.notes: Session ID may be recorded; IP collection awaits an explicit privacy policy.

entries.label: Correlation and request ID
entries.notes: Stable across the decision and resulting evidence.
